_comment: Small, fixed, hand-authored regression dataset for ai/evaluation - consumed ONLY by tests/ai/evaluation/test_golden_dataset.py. Deliberately generic/synthetic (no real video content, no domain-specific entities) so it never needs updating when product content changes. Unlike example_retrieval_queries.json / example_rag_questions.json (schema templates for a real deployment's own data), every expected score for this dataset is hand-computed and asserted in the test - it exists to catch a future regression in metric math or BenchmarkRunner's aggregation, not to measure this deployment's real retrieval/RAG quality.

generation_cases.reference: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
